preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to manipulate fee parameters and trigger supply divergence
Attacker needs sufficient KARMA tokens to trigger transfers that activate the burn mechanism

exploit_hint: 1. As owner, call setSellFeePercentages() to set burnFeeOnSell > 0. 2. Execute token transfers to/from Uniswap pair to trigger _takeLiquidity() function. 3. The burnAmount calculation in _takeLiquidity() reduces _tTotalSupply but not _tTotal, creating divergence. 4. Verify that totalSupply() no longer equals the sum of all account balances, breaking the ERC20 invariant and corrupting the reflection rate calculation.
